summary: Iter 12 covered 4 feature areas: (1) Public Org Structure page (/struktur-organisasi, data-testid=public-org-link on /login) — accessible without login, lists all non-demo structures. Verified by creating 2 real-admin structures (TEST_UI_PUB_A/B), confirmed tabs render (public-org-tab-{id}), switching tabs updates public-org-title and public-org-tree, then cleaned up. (2) Dana Sosial edit/delete — PATCH/DELETE /api/social-fund/{id} works for ketua_osis & super_admin; kepsek receives 403; UI shows sf-edit-{id}/sf-delete-{id} for osis.demo (1 row visible) and none for kepsek. (3) Classes password & unlock — super_admin bypass confirmed; kelas.demo & siswa.demo already unlocked for XI IPA 1 (no class-unlock-page shown); wrong password returns 400. (4) Class Kas — ketua_kelas can POST/PATCH/DELETE; siswa gets 403; super_admin gets 403 (per spec ketua_kelas only); kas-balance/kas-amount-input/kas-add-button render for ketua_kelas; kas-readonly-note shows for siswa; kas export returns xlsx. /uang-kas redirects to /classes. (5) Attendance barcode — barcode-scanner-card renders below QR, 'Scan QR Code' title still present; barcode-input disabled until barcode-toggle-button pressed; API records attendance with method='barcode' via NISN; invalid method returns 400; attendance export works. Backend pytest: 15/15 PASSED. Frontend Playwright: all critical selectors verified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~2220 lines; still functional but approaching the 'split into modules' threshold flagged in prior iterations.
BarcodeScanner.jsx auto-refocus with onBlur+setTimeout works, but if a focus-stealing modal opens the loop may fight it. Low priority.
ClassKas.jsx exportXlsx uses URL.createObjectURL without revokeObjectURL — tiny memory leak per export. Non-blocking.
assert_kas_manager permits only ketua_kelas of the exact class; super_admin cannot create kas rows. This matches the spec but may surprise admins managing seeded demos — spec takes precedence.
seed_data_creation: pytest TEST_PUB_* org-structures & TEST_SF_* social-fund rows (cleaned up in-test). UI test created & deleted TEST_UI_PUB_A/B structures via real admin for tabs verification.
